recap.analyst:
Coloso Ciudad and Guanabara FC drew 1-1. On expected goals it finished 0.46–0.49: the chances were close to even, so the result is about right.

Guanabara FC had 57% of the ball. Pass completion COL 64% (83/130), GUA 74% (147/198). Shots 6–5, on target 1–0.

Coloso Ciudad started in a 4-2-3-1 (direct), Guanabara FC in a 5-4-1 (direct). Neither coach changed shape.

Turning point, 8': T. Nagadate was sent off (a second yellow). Coloso Ciudad played the rest with ten, which usually costs a side about a third of its attacking output.

By the numbers: P. Djedele completed the most passes (33); K. Hartvik hit the top speed (33.3 km/h); Z. Abakuma covered the most ground (6.23 km, a 17.5 km per-90 pace); K. Hartvik won the most challenges (13).

Discipline: fouls 5–3, yellows 2–0, reds 1–0, offsides 0–1. Conditions: partly cloudy, 21°C, pitch damp.
recap.fan: A tense, tight night at Estadio Coloso, Mexico City. B. Talnila broke the deadlock in the 10th minute. Then an own goal in the 14th gave Guanabara FC another. And the red card changed everything. Guanabara FC had more of the ball, but neither side could find a winner. The hero: B. Talnila, with the goal that mattered. Honours even. Both sets of fans go home with something.
